controls.objective: Establish and record a lawful basis and a defined purpose for each dataset, limit processing to that purpose.
controls.recommended_config: Require a configured lawful_basis per dataset, record a processing-activity (RoPA) entry, enable purpose labels at ingest.

controls.objective: Provide workflows for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, with SLA tracking.
controls.recommended_config: Enable a subject-request workflow with SLA timers, link requests to affected records, record fulfilment evidence.

controls.objective: Require a documented risk assessment for large-scale or special-category processing, linked to the pipeline.
controls.recommended_config: Require a DPIA for qualifying datasets, link the DPIA to the ingestion pipeline, record residual-risk sign-off.

controls.objective: Constrain storage location and cross-border transfer to lawful regions or adequate safeguards.
controls.recommended_config: Set a deployment-region flag, encrypt in transit and at rest, configure a cross-region replication + transfer-safeguard policy.

controls.objective: Respond to public-access / freedom-of-information requests within the statutory timeline, publish non-exempt records.
controls.recommended_config: Provide a request workflow + redaction queue + SLA timers + an audit-proof response export.

controls.objective: Tag and minimise special-category data (e.g. health), bind processors contractually, meet breach-notification windows.
controls.recommended_config: Apply special-category tagging, require processor agreements, configure breach-notification timers + contacts.

controls.objective: Capture machine-readable provenance for every AI-derived assertion, register models with version and evaluation metrics.
controls.recommended_config: Record append-only provenance events (model name/version/config/confidence), maintain a model registry with evaluation sets and drift monitoring.

controls.objective: Require human validation for high-risk actions (disposal, transfer, sensitive access).
controls.recommended_config: Drive confidence-threshold review queues, assign reviewer roles, record every review decision.

controls.objective: Maintain signed, append-only audit logs and exportable chain-of-custody manifests.
controls.recommended_config: Use an append-only log store with server-signed entries, support a chain-of-custody export (e.g. METS / bagit).

mappings.obligation: Lawful basis and purpose limitation for processing personal data
mappings.recommended_config: Configure lawful_basis, record RoPA, enable purpose labels

mappings.obligation: Impact assessment for large-scale / special-category processing
mappings.recommended_config: Require a DPIA linked to the pipeline
Region flag, transfer safeguards, encrypted replication

mappings.obligation: Publication / access on request, exemptions, statutory timelines
mappings.recommended_config: Redaction queue, SLA timers, audit-proof export

mappings.obligation: Special-category handling, processor agreements, breach notification
mappings.recommended_config: Special-category tagging, processor agreements, breach timers

mappings.obligation: Individual access to held personal/health data
mappings.recommended_config: Subject-request workflow scoped to health records
